<subject>RE: Ironridge/Whistler</subject>
<body>
Dear Kay,

We advised Hartley & Co. that we would provide our Guarantee and Legal Opinion at the closing scheduled for Wednesday. They agreed to this arrangement. If this poses any issues, I can send the guarantee and opinion (once signed) by fax, accompanied by a letter from me stating that you are unable to release it until funding is confirmed.

Best regards,  
Kent

-----Original Message-----  
From: kay.mann@tasmanridge.com.au  
Sent: Tuesday, 1 May 2021 9:59 AM  
To: lee.johnson@ss.ps.tasmanridge.com.au; kent.shoemaker@tasmanridge.com.au  
Cc: jake.thomas@tasmanridge.com.au; stephen.thome@tasmanridge.com.au  
Subject: Ironridge/Whistler

Good morning,

To finalize Ironridge/Whistler by tomorrow, please note we require the following today:

- Tasman Ridge parent guarantee  
- Letter of Credit (to enable full payment to Tasman Ridge tomorrow)  
- Legal opinion

Additionally, once funds are received by Tasman Ridge, we will need a receipt confirmation letter.

Lee, I have not yet heard back from the Melbourne team regarding the status of the LV Co Gen contract. Perhaps Jake can assist in expediting this.

Thank you,  
Kay
</body>
